title: Continuity of active commuting to school across two generations: the Cardiovascular Risk in Young Finns Study.
authors: Suominen TH, Kukko T, Yang X, Pahkala K, Rovio S, Hirvensalo M, Kähönen M, Raitakari O, Tammelin TH, Salin K.
figures: Distributions of home–school distances among G1 and G2 generations according to school grade (primary school  n  = 381, lower secondary school  n  = 155, and upper secondary school  n  = 124, for both G1 and G2).

Unadjusted proportions of active commuters among G1 and G2 generations according to distance to school, separately for the school grades (primary school  n  = 381, lower secondary school  n  = 155, and upper secondary school  n  = 124, for both G1 and G2).

Directed acyclic graph of the path model ( n  = 660, for both G1 and G2) of ACS across two generations with its covariates. Values are standardized regression coefficients (SE). Model fit: X 2  = 9.9 (df 11);  P  = .538; CFI = 1; TLI = 1; RMSEA = 0; and SRMR = 0.066.
